scientific_protocol_compatibility.existing_event_rich_v3: incompatible: v3 freezes B/C as its two co-primary candidates and selects classes separately for B and C
scientific_protocol_compatibility.same_pool_option: before any real screen sampling, explicitly freeze a scientific v4 that replaces the blur-family co-primary set with B/E, rewrites selector targets, Holm family, event gates, label-free products, and evaluator, and moves C to a separately declared diagnostic or independent family
scientific_protocol_compatibility.separate_pool_option: leave event-rich v3 unchanged and evaluate E only in a later independent pool with disjoint calibration and confirmation seeds
scientific_protocol_compatibility.forbidden: silently add E to the v3 confirmation or evaluate E on a pool whose classes were selected by v3 B/C rules and call it confirmatory

scientific_question: Does an exact cross-scale operational path likelihood ratio add blur/fusion failure information beyond the already frozen preterminal B statistic when Q* is activated and localized only by the current B state?

observation_window.latest_observation: after the model prediction at sampling step 149 and before its transition innovation

cross_scale_components.mapping_rule: nearest internal timestep to nu_current+Delta_nu among equal-or-higher-noise timesteps; ties prefer higher noise

B_internal_statistic.derivatives: Gaussian sigma 0.7, Sobel gx/gy divided by 8, and discrete Laplacian
B_internal_statistic.active_tiles: eight highest grayscale-variance tiles with stable row-major tie breaking
B_internal_statistic.pure_B_score: B_persistence=mean(B_k over the nine frozen checkpoints)

label_free_calibration.seed_binding: must be frozen by the compatible scientific protocol; scientific v4 may bind the still-unused v3-planned calibration cohort only if v3 is explicitly superseded before sampling, while a later independent pool must use new disjoint seeds
label_free_calibration.state_gate_threshold: for each class and checkpoint, the 17th ascending B_k among 20 calibration paths; gate opens only under strict B_k>threshold
label_free_calibration.state_gate_interpretation: predictable sparsification of Q*, not a false-positive guarantee and not an alarm; for one fresh exchangeable path at one fixed checkpoint, strict exceedance has rank probability 4/21
label_free_calibration.pure_B_alarm_threshold: for each class, the 19th ascending B_persistence among 20 calibration paths; strict score>threshold
label_free_calibration.pure_B_marginal_trigger_bound: under within-class exchangeability, at most 2/21; this is an overall trigger budget, not clean-good conditional FPR
label_free_calibration.calibrator_input_whitelist: sample/class/seed identifiers, frozen checkpoint axes, and decoded_local_blur_severity only; endpoint CSV, labels, reviews, external representations, and all coexisting non-B tracks are not loaded
label_free_calibration.calibrator_lineage: threshold JSON binds source manifest identity, time-series hash, loaded-array hashes, the common 20-seed cohort, and calibrator source hash

blur_gated_operational_Q_star.focus_tiles: the two lowest-q tiles among the current eight active B tiles, ties by row-major tile index
blur_gated_operational_Q_star.latent_localization: same normalized 4x4 coordinates in the 32x32 latent; all four channels retained
blur_gated_operational_Q_star.state_gate: a_k=1{B_k exceeds its frozen class/checkpoint label-free threshold}
blur_gated_operational_Q_star.allowance: at each nonidentity checkpoint, the allowance is that sample/scale component's complete remaining path budget; a closed gate spends zero, a strong first open gate may spend the full K_total, and any residual from a weak direction carries forward by a rule computed before the next innovation
blur_gated_operational_Q_star.second_moment_bound_per_component: E_P[E_T^2]<=exp(2*K_total)=exp(4), a deliberately looser bound accepted only after the frozen matched-Q power gate rejected K_total=0.5 as powerless
blur_gated_operational_Q_star.semantic_caveat: the predictable B gate, local mask, and binding KL scaling define a different operational alternative Q*; exact Q*/P accounting does not restore the ideal p_(v+Delta)/p_v semantics; normalized image-tile to latent-tile mapping is only a frozen localization heuristic because the VAE decoder is nonlocal

pre_real_trace_matched_Q_power_gate.purpose: reject an e-process that is perfectly calibrated but nearly unable to cross its own threshold even under its matched operational alternative
pre_real_trace_matched_Q_power_gate.model: two orthogonal scalar Gaussian component directions; generate from each matched Q_d in turn; the matched component spends its complete K at its first eligible gate and the other coordinate remains P
pre_real_trace_matched_Q_power_gate.analytic_reference: if the nonmatched mixture component were fixed at E=1, the matched component must reach E=19; under full K=2 its terminal log-LR is N(2,4), giving about 0.318 reference power
pre_real_trace_matched_Q_power_gate.scope: necessary oracle full-budget gate, not a quality result and not sufficient for real power
additional_label_free_real_gate_before_l: evaluate on at least 60 paths before making the aggregate gate decision
report fraction of paths with at least one B state gate open for each scale
report fraction of gate-open paths that actually use at least K=1.5 per scale
STOP before opening labels if either scale has fewer than 50 percent gate-open paths or fewer than 50 percent of gate-open paths reach K=1.5

candidate_family.multiple_testing: Holm step-down across exactly the two co-primary raw class-matched permutation p-values

fixed_diagnostics_and_ablations.B_formation_slope: OLS slope of the nine B_k values against checkpoint index; diagnostic only
fixed_diagnostics_and_ablations.E_no_state_gate: same focus masks, cross-scale directions, heat shifts, mixture, and KL budgets, but a_k=1 at every nonidentity checkpoint; exact operational e-process, ablation only
fixed_diagnostics_and_ablations.rank_one_no_shrink_witness: rewriting the full whitened mean shift as ||w|| times w/||w|| gives exactly the same LR and is not a collapse remedy

confirmation_design.confirmation_seed_binding: not set by this method-only lock; a compatible scientific v4 or a later independent-pool protocol must bind unused seeds before sampling
confirmation_design.visual_label_join_stage: only after endpoint labels, reviewer reliability, event counts, trace products, source identities, and label-free thresholds are independently locked

B_persistence: at its frozen label-free threshold, TPR>FPR
E_blur_gated: at least three blur/fusion positives cross the anytime threshold

incremental_value_tests.E_beyond_B: report paired class-matched DeltaAUC=AUC(E_blur_gated)-AUC(B_persistence); a positive method-addition claim requires DeltaAUC>0 and a predeclared one-sided paired seed-block permutation p<0.05
incremental_value_tests.B_gate_beyond_localization: report paired DeltaAUC=AUC(E_blur_gated)-AUC(E_no_state_gate); a B-gating mechanism claim requires DeltaAUC>0
incremental_value_tests.operating_point: compare B-alone and E_blur_gated TPR/FPR at their separately frozen approximately ten-percent overall intervention budgets

falsification_and_stop_rules: If any gate, mask, direction, scale, scale weight, or KL scaling depends on the current transition innovation or a later state, the exact e-process claim fails.
If the observation hook changes any baseline latent, RNG state, transition draw, or endpoint pixel, the implementation fails.
If any scale component exceeds total K=2.0, the collapse-control contract fails.
If the frozen matched-Q synthetic gate or the later label-free real gate-open/K-utilization gate fails, stop before any label join.
If E_blur_gated fails its independent quality gates, do not intervene and do not reinterpret exact calibration as quality evidence.
If E_blur_gated does not add information beyond pure B, retain B as a heuristic detector but drop the sequential-evidence contribution claim.
If E_blur_gated does not improve over E_no_state_gate, drop the claim that the B state gate adds value.
A failed v1 cannot be rescued by selecting another tile count, checkpoint window, heat shift, sign, channel, aggregation, or threshold on the confirmation pool.
forbidden_method_inputs: FID or any batch endpoint metric
any candidate value or threshold selected after seeing confirmation labels
allowed_external_evaluation_only: locked endpoint visual labels may be joined by a separate evaluator solely to falsify the frozen internal candidates; external representations are not required even for evaluation
